name: Sulfonethylmethane
summary: Trional (Methylsulfonal) is a sedative-hypnotic and anesthetic drug with GABAergic actions. It has similar effects to Sulfonal, except it is faster acting.

pharmacology.text: Trional (Methylsulfonal) is a sedative-hypnotic and anesthetic drug with GABAergic actions.

uses.text: Trional (Methylsulfonal) is a sedative-hypnotic and anesthetic drug with GABAergic actions.

sideEffects.en: It is no longer used. Drugs of its type, the sulfonal hypnotics, built up in the body with repeated use and could cause confusion, unsteadiness and poisoning, including porphyria, a disorder that can turn urine dark red.
sideEffects.zh: 它已不再使用。這類sulfonal型安眠藥在反覆使用後會在體內累積，可能造成意識混亂、步態不穩與中毒，包括紫質症，這種疾病可能使尿液變成深紅色。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它已不再使用。这类sulfonal型安眠药在反复使用后会在体内累积，可能造成意识混乱、步态不稳与中毒，包括紫质症，这种疾病可能使尿液变成深红色。

fact.en: Trional was one of the first synthetic sleeping drugs of the late 1800s. It is a close relative of sulfonal, with an ethyl group in place of one of sulfonal's methyl groups.
fact.zh: Trional是1800年代末最早的合成安眠藥之一。它是sulfonal的近親，把sulfonal的其中一個甲基換成了乙基。
fact.zhHans: Trional是1800年代末最早的合成安眠药之一。它是sulfonal的近亲，把sulfonal的其中一个甲基换成了乙基。
